purpose: Deterministic, technical-only import manifest. Cross-references docs/evidence/DRIFT-IV-PRE-20/licensed-asset-provenance-registry.json by registry id; does not repeat licence conclusions, only measured technical facts.

method.glb_parsing: Standard-library-only Python (struct + json modules): read the 12-byte GLB header (magic 'glTF', version uint32, total length uint32), then iterate chunks (chunk length uint32 + 4-byte type + payload); the 'JSON' chunk is parsed as the glTF document, the 'BIN\x00' chunk's length is recorded. Triangle counts are estimated by summing accessor.count/3 for every primitive with mode==4 (TRIANGLES) that has an indices accessor.
method.image_inspection: Pillow (PIL) Image.open() + .load() to force a real decode (not just a header read), then .size/.mode/.format read directly.
method.hashing: PowerShell Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256, run directly against the downloaded file on disk.
